description: Every mixed language (Hinglish, Tenglish, Tanglish, Kanglish, Manglish, Marathi-English, Benglish). Deterministic: every message must be in Roman script, with no Devanagari, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada or Malayalam characters. A judge rates whether the mix sounds natural.

inputs.message: Yaar, mera boss weekend pe bhi kaam deta hai. Kya karun?
Namaste! ChaiCart metro stations ke bahar 12 electric chai carts chalata hai. Hum ₹25 lakh maang rahe hain 10% ke liye.
Neural networks kaise seekhte hain, simple mein samjhao.
Ra, naa manager weekends lo kuda pani istunnadu. Em cheyyali?
Offer vachindi ra. Vellalani undi, kani amma nanna ni vadili vellalante guilty ga undi.
Naa resume ni roast cheyyandi, mohamatam lekunda.
Machan, en boss weekend-la kooda velai kudukkaru. Enna pannalaam?
Namaskara! ChaiCart metro station hatra 12 electric chai carts nadesutte. Naavu 10% ge 25 lakh kelta iddivi.
Neural networks engane aanu padikkunnathu? Simple aayi parayamo?
Offer aali aahe. Jaavasa vaatatay, pan aai-baba la sodun jaayla guilty vaatatay.
Amar resume ta roast koro, ekdom kono doya korbe na.
